Compassionate Care for Your Pets

At Willow Creek Vet Clinic, we treat every patient like family. From routine checkups to urgent care, our experienced team is here to keep your dogs, cats, and other beloved companions happy and healthy.

Explore Our Services

Why Pet Owners Choose Willow Creek

Experienced, Caring Team

Our vets and technicians bring decades of combined experience and a genuine love for animals to every visit.

Modern Facilities

From digital X-rays to an in-house lab, we use up-to-date equipment to diagnose and treat your pet quickly and accurately.

Always Here When You Need Us

With extended weekday hours and a 24/7 emergency line, help is never far away for your furry family members.

Pet Emergency?

If your pet is experiencing a medical emergency, don't wait. Call our 24/7 emergency line immediately at (555) 204-7799, or head to the clinic right away.

Emergency Contact Details

Ready to Book a Visit?

Whether it's time for an annual wellness exam or you simply have questions about your pet's health, our friendly staff is ready to help.

Book an AppointmentMeet Our Vets

Willow Creek Vet Clinic

1420 Maple Grove Road, Brookfield, IL 60513

Phone: (555) 204-7788 · Email: care@willowcreekvet.com

Open Mon–Sat, 8:00am–6:00pm. 24/7 emergency line available.

pages.title: Our Services — Willow Creek Vet Clinic
pages.html:
🐾Willow Creek Vet Clinic
HomeServicesOur VetsContact & Emergency

Our Services

Comprehensive Care Under One Roof

From routine checkups to surgery and dental work, our team provides full-spectrum veterinary care for dogs, cats, and small mammals. Prices below are starting estimates — your vet will confirm an exact quote after an examination, since every pet's needs are different.

Our Treatments & Pricing

Wellness Exams

Annual Wellness Exam

A head-to-tail physical check-up to catch problems early and keep your pet's preventive care on track.

From $55

Senior Pet Check-Up

Extra bloodwork and joint assessments tailored to the needs of pets aged seven and up.

From $85

New Puppy / Kitten Visit

A gentle first visit covering growth checks, parasite screening, and a personalised care plan.

From $65

Vaccinations

Core Vaccine Package

Protects against the most common and serious canine or feline diseases, including rabies.

From $45

Lifestyle Vaccines

Optional protection such as kennel cough or feline leukaemia, recommended based on your pet's lifestyle.

From $30

Titer Testing

Blood test to check existing immunity levels before deciding whether a booster is needed.

From $70

Surgery

Spay / Neuter

Routine sterilisation surgery performed under full anaesthesia with post-op pain management included.

From $220

Mass Removal

Surgical removal of skin lumps or growths, with histopathology available on request.

From $275

Soft Tissue Surgery

From foreign object removal to abscess repair, our vets handle a wide range of surgical needs.

From $350

Dental Care

Dental Check & Clean

Ultrasonic scaling and polishing under anaesthesia, plus a full oral health assessment.

From $195

Tooth Extraction

Gentle removal of damaged or diseased teeth, with pain relief sent home for recovery.

From $90 per tooth

At-Home Care Kit

Toothbrush, enzymatic paste, and a dental chew starter pack with a guided demonstration.

From $25

Grooming

Bath & Brush-Out

Shampoo suited to your pet's skin type, full brush-out, nail trim, and ear cleaning.

From $40

Full Groom

Breed-appropriate haircut, de-shedding treatment, and finishing spritz for a fresh look.

From $65

Nail Trim Only

A quick, low-stress nail trim — perfect for pets between full grooming visits.

From $15

A Note on Pricing, Insurance & Payment Plans

Pet Insurance

We work with most major pet insurance providers and are happy to provide itemised invoices for reimbursement claims. Ask our front desk team for a claim form at your visit.

Payment Plans

For larger treatments like surgery or dental work, we offer flexible payment plans so cost is never a barrier to care. Speak with our team before your appointment to set one up.

All prices listed are starting estimates based on a healthy pet of average size. Final cost may vary depending on your pet's weight, condition, and any additional tests required. A full quote is always provided before treatment begins.

Need Urgent Care?

If your pet is experiencing an emergency, don't wait for a scheduled appointment.

Call our 24/7 emergency line: (555) 204-7799

View Emergency Contact Details

Willow Creek Vet Clinic

1420 Maple Grove Road, Brookfield, IL 60513

Phone: (555) 204-7788 · Email: care@willowcreekvet.com

Open Mon–Sat, 8:00am–6:00pm. 24/7 emergency line available.

© 2024 Willow Creek Vet Clinic. All rights reserved.

pages.title: Meet Our Vets — Willow Creek Vet Clinic
pages.html:
🐾Willow Creek Vet Clinic
HomeServicesOur VetsContact & Emergency

Meet Our Vets

At Willow Creek Vet Clinic, every member of our team shares one goal: treating your pet with the same patience, warmth, and clinical skill we'd want for our own animals. Our veterinarians and support staff bring decades of combined experience across general medicine, surgery, dentistry, and emergency care — and they genuinely like what they do.

We believe trust is built through clear communication, so you'll always know what's happening with your pet and why. Scroll down to get to know the faces behind the care.

Our Veterinarians & Staff

Dr. Elena Marsh, DVM

Founder & Lead Veterinarian

DVM, University of Illinois · 18 years in small animal practice

Dr. Marsh founded Willow Creek in 2006 with a simple mission: accessible, honest veterinary care for every pet in Brookfield. She specializes in internal medicine and geriatric care, and still makes house calls for long-time patients who can't easily travel.

Dr. Samuel Osei, DVM

Veterinary Surgeon

DVM, Purdue University · Certified in Veterinary Surgery

Dr. Osei leads our surgical department, from routine spay/neuter procedures to orthopedic repairs. Pet owners often mention how thoroughly he explains every step before and after surgery, easing a lot of worry.

Dr. Priya Nair, DVM

Veterinarian, Feline & Exotic Medicine

DVM, Cornell University · Certificate in Avian & Exotic Medicine

Dr. Nair has a soft spot for the patients other clinics turn away — rabbits, birds, reptiles, and especially nervous cats. Her gentle, low-stress handling techniques make a real difference for anxious animals.

Marcus Reed, LVT

Lead Veterinary Technician

Licensed Veterinary Technician, 9 years' experience

Marcus coordinates diagnostics, anesthesia monitoring, and patient recovery. He's usually the calm, steady hands your pet meets first — and the one who remembers every dog's favorite treat.

Dana Whitfield

Client Care Coordinator

10 years in veterinary administration

Dana manages scheduling, billing questions, and the front desk with a reassuring, friendly manner. If you call or walk in with a question, she's usually the first voice you'll hear.

Jordan Lee

Veterinary Assistant

Certified Veterinary Assistant, 4 years' experience

Jordan supports exams, treatments, and boarding patients, and has a particular talent for helping scared pets feel safe within minutes of arriving.

Committed to Continued Learning

Veterinary medicine keeps evolving, and so do we. Every member of our clinical team completes ongoing continuing education each year, and our veterinarians regularly attend conferences on topics ranging from pain management to advanced diagnostics. We're also active members of the American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) and the Illinois State Veterinary Medical Association.

Have a question about a specific condition or which vet might be the best fit for your pet's needs? We're happy to talk it through.

Contact Our Team

Willow Creek Vet Clinic

1420 Maple Grove Road, Brookfield, IL 60513

Phone: (555) 204-7788 · Email: care@willowcreekvet.com

Open Mon–Sat, 8:00am–6:00pm. 24/7 emergency line available.

© 2024 Willow Creek Vet Clinic. All rights reserved.

24/7 Emergency Line

If your pet is experiencing a life-threatening emergency — difficulty breathing, severe bleeding, seizures, suspected poisoning, or trauma — call us immediately, any time of day or night.

Call Emergency Line Now
